HANGAR-AMBER SODIUM WASH — elevated sodium-mast floodlights pouring warm orange across the deployment-bay floor, hard yellow shadows stretching long behind mech legs, distant control-panel cyan accents cooling the far wall.

EMERGENCY-RED STROBE PULSING — rotating red emergency beacons firing in rhythm across the launch corridor, mech silhouetted hard between pulses, floor-shadows snapping direction with each strobe cycle, urgency immediate.

DAWN-DEPLOYMENT DUAL-COLOR — cold pre-sunrise blue holding the lower frame and shadow zones, first orange warmth catching only the mech's upper shoulders and cockpit dome, every chassis rivet readable in dual-color contrast.

LAUNCH-SILO PULSING-ORANGE — amber alert-strobes rotating inside the vertical silo cavity, concentric warm-pulse rings climbing the silo walls, lower launch-pit shadow zones holding cold cobalt, vertical drama extreme.

NIGHT MECH-RUNNING-LIGHTS — cold cobalt ambient base, chassis running-lights in amber and cyan providing primary hull illumination, cockpit interior glow washing the pilot's access ladder, deep sky behind reading near-black.

NEON-CYBERPUNK URBAN HANGAR — magenta and cyan commercial sign-lights bleeding through the open hangar mouth from the city district outside, wet deck puddles reflecting both colors, dramatic underside uplight catching the mech's lower chassis.

RAIN-WET NIGHT PAD — single elevated backlight source cutting through rainfall, wet hangar-deck doubling the mech in reflection, droplets catching specular along the pilot's shoulders, cold ambient holding the surrounding dark.

HARD KEY-LIGHT INSPECTION — single overhead intensity spotlight dropped onto the mech's forward chassis plate, pilot and technician reading in deep surrounding shadow, shadow boundaries razor-hard across riveted hull panels, theatrical and clinical.

OVERCAST DEPLOYMENT-FIELD — uniform low-cloud blanket diffusing all directionality, mech formation reading in muted cool-grey tones, ground surface bouncing soft fill upward into chassis undersides, near-zero shadow contrast across the line.

DUSK FIRE-GLOW POST-COMBAT — burning installation off-frame casting warm orange uplight across the mech's underside and the pilot's visor, atmospheric smoke haze backlit orange at distance, end-of-mission weight heavy in the color.
